correctness.rationale: The exact Type-1 objective-gap condition and strong convexity imply \(2rQ\le-\|u-x\|^2-\|p-x\|^2+\varepsilon^2\); the observable criterion then yields \(Q\le-(1-\kappa)\|u-x\|^2/r\). The scalar zero-penalty extremizers saturate each inequality and prove the endpoint barrier. Algorithm 2 nonterminal geometric refinement terminates for all \(0<\kappa<1\). Source Theorem 12 supplies \(\kappa_{\mathrm{fcd}}=(1-\kappa)\min\{1-\kappa,r_{\min}\}/2\). Source Theorem 10 first clause gives \(\liminf\Psi_k=0\); \(\bar\Psi_k\le(1+\kappa)\Psi_k\), its Lemma 2, and Assumption 3.1 yield the remaining limiting-stationarity assertion. Exact-rational checker executed successfully; it is not used as an infinite proof. Terminal handling for \(p=x\), outer oracle assumptions and limiting-not-full convergence are stated explicitly.

value.rationale: The primary algorithm's tolerance \(\kappa<1/2\) controls computational work, yet its Cauchy model can maintain certified decrease and outer limit-inferior stationarity throughout the larger strict interval \(0<\kappa<1\). The boundary is sharp for the very same Type-1 error observable and an exact scalar example; the derivation also removes dependence on the unknown exact-step precision condition (25), improving implementability. It is a meaningful algorithm-specific parameter and convergence-theory improvement, not an arbitrary slice, numerical table lookup, or mere normalization.
